$comment: S10 · SAMPLE DATA ONLY — Smart Rules and notices for the made-up sample store of the sample catalogue (PR 14), so the Smart Rules screens of the approved demo (docs/demo/src/81-admin-rules.js, 01-data.js DB.rules) can be built and tested against real rows. The values are the demo's sample figures (money in poisha), never the owner's charges, prices or discounts (PR 509, CLAUDE.md rules 4 and 6). Applied only by `pnpm --filter @extas/rules sample`, only to the store the sample seed made; it refuses any other store. The sample exchange rule is switched on by the seed so the storefront pieces have a live rule to read — its history says it was the sample seed in a made-up shop, not an owner decision; the other rules that move money stay drafts, so the owner's-OK step is what the screens show. One notice deliberately writes "7 days" by hand so the conflict banner (PR 217) has something to show.
